title: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops
content:
SOP: Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops (SOP-AMB-001)
DEPARTMENT: Emergency Department
VERSION: 2.4
ROLES: driver, paramedic, emergency_team
PURPOSE: Dispatch ALS ambulance within 5 minutes of emergency call receipt.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops in full compliance with Emergency Department hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Emergency Department.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-AMB-001 Emergency Ambulance Dispatch and Fleet Ops v2.4, Section 4
